programs.name: Trader Career Path (TCP50)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD in the evaluation and on LiveSim accounts; intraday trailing on Live accounts (stops rising at the starting balance)
programs.consistency_rule: 30% in evaluation only (no single day may be 30% or more of total PnL; exceeding it is not a fail, you keep trading). None on LiveSim/Live accounts
programs.profit_split: Per withdrawal: 50% if the withdrawal is under $2,250, 80% if it is $2,250 or more
programs.payout_frequency: weekly (processed on Wednesdays; request by email by 2:00 PM CT the preceding Friday)
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum net withdrawal $100; no buffer requirement. $139 activation fee (LiveSim, non-professional CME status) is deducted from the first withdrawal; Live accounts have no activation fee but pay market data of $140/month/exchange (Rithmic) or $156 (NinjaTrader). LiveSim max cumulative withdrawal on TCP50 is $3,000, after which the trader is moved to a Live account. Growth plan: hitting the $3,000 goal and withdrawing moves the trader to a $100K Live account, and so on up to $400K (TCP400 has a fixed 60/40 split).
programs.notes: Sold in 25K/50K/100K starting sizes (TCP25 $150/mo, TCP100 per help center price list). 50K price seen on the /non-us product page. Free reset after every monthly rebill (from the first rebill). Contracts follow a progression ladder up to 6; exceeding the allowed size is a hard fail. Positions must be closed by 3:50 PM CT. Up to 5 concurrent evaluations; up to 3 funded accounts, only 1 of them Live.

programs.name: Gauntlet Mini (GAU50)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD in the evaluation and on LiveSim accounts; intraday trailing on Live accounts
programs.consistency_rule: 30% in evaluation only; none on funded accounts
programs.profit_split: Per withdrawal: 50% if under $2,250, 80% if $2,250 or more
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum net withdrawal $100. LiveSim max cumulative withdrawal on GM50 is $5,000, after which the trader is moved to a Live account. $139 LiveSim activation fee from the first withdrawal; Live accounts pay monthly data fees instead. No growth plan: funded account stays at the evaluation size.
programs.notes: Sizes 50K/100K/150K/200K. Contracts follow the Gauntlet Mini progression ladder up to 6 on 50K. Fixed reset prices for larger sizes: $100 (100K), $130 (150K), $155 (200K); 50K reset price is dynamic and below the current new-subscription price.

copy_trading: Not allowed: trade copiers are banned on all programs, before and after funding; accounts passed with a copier can be denied and are not refunded
overnight_weekend_holding: No overnight holding in evaluations: all positions and orders must be closed by 3:50 PM CT (earlier for some agricultural and livestock contracts).
restricted_countries_note: Citizens of these countries cannot get funded: Afghanistan, Albania, Azerbaijan, Burma (Myanmar), Central African Republic, Cuba, Gibraltar, Iran, Iraq, Kenya, Libya, Mali, Nauru, Nigeria, North Korea, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen. The list restricts funding (not the evaluation purchase); non-US citizens need a W-8BEN with a foreign tax ID. Rise payouts are not available in Iowa, Minnesota, South Carolina, Guam, Puerto Rico, USVI or Haiti.
path_to_live: After passing, the trader chooses a LiveSim (simulated, EOD drawdown) or a Live account (real brokerage account with a partner prop firm, trailing drawdown, own data fees). LiveSim traders are moved to Live after reaching the LiveSim max withdrawal ($3,000 on TCP50, $5,000 on GM50). TCP Live accounts grow by profit goal: $50K -> $100K -> ... up to $400K

current_public_promo.applies_to: Shown on Earn2Trade's US site; the non-US site showed a different offer without a code

affiliate_program.commission: 20% on all sales of all products, for as long as the referred customer stays (lifetime)
affiliate_program.notes: Application with approval; affiliates get a personalised 20% discount link and coupon for referrals. Monthly payouts, $300 minimum. Serbia: eligibility of Serbian residents is not stated on the affiliate page.

recent_changes_2026.change: Help center article dated 6 Jul 2026 states that exceeding the TCP progression ladder contract limit is a hard fail that ends the evaluation

pros: In business since 2016; Trustpilot 4.5 from 5,026 reviews
Option to trade a real Live brokerage account right after passing, and the TCP growth plan scales Live accounts up to $400K
No minimum trading days, news trading allowed, no consistency rule or buffer on funded accounts
Weekly withdrawals from $100; activation fee ($139) is taken from the first withdrawal, not paid upfront
cons: Funded split is only 50% on any withdrawal under $2,250 (50K); 80% needs a larger single withdrawal
Evaluations are monthly subscriptions ($190 TCP50, $170 GAU50 list) that renew until cancelled
Live accounts use an intraday trailing drawdown and carry monthly data fees ($140/exchange on Rithmic)
No overnight holding in evaluations (flat by 3:50 PM CT); trade copiers banned; ladder breaches are a hard fail
Firm-published 2025 pass rate was 8.89%, and only about 18% of funded accounts had a withdrawal
best_for: Futures day traders who want a path from a monthly-billed evaluation to a real Live brokerage account, with a scaling plan up to $400K and no minimum trading days.
